For the people behind the event

Bring the experience beyond the floor plan.

Signs, links, booths and individual activations can feel disconnected. We bring them into a shared spatial experience, built around the place and its purpose.

For visitors, it starts simply: scan or tap, enter the space, explore.

One way in.
More ways to interact.

  1. 01

    Scan. Tap. Enter.

  2. 02

    Explore the space.

    Discover the venue in 3D and open its available spatial experiences. AR access depends on the device and browser.

    3D / AR

    Open the next layer.

    Add identity and transactions when an experience needs them. The wallet layer is currently a Stellar Testnet pilot.

The first public experience

ONE16Lisbon, Portugal

A real venue becomes the starting point for a spatial experience you can enter today.

Walk through the arrival corridor, gathering areas, stands and main stage. Discover the Stellar Passport demonstration and the next steps of the wallet pilot. This independent interpretation does not imply an official partnership.

Explore ONE16↗

An experience with room to evolve

A space can do more than display content.

We start with a place people can explore, then add the capabilities that make sense for its owner, partners and visitors.

Available

A shared spatial experience

The ONE16 3D venue, QR/NFC entry points and the Passport demonstration form the current experience.

Pilot

Wallet access in Stellar Testnet

Passkey wallets, session continuity and test USDC funding are being validated. Test assets have no real value.

Planned

Programmable advertising

Smart contracts for advertising placements and brand experiences, with rules defined by the space owner.

Recorded testnet run

Authorized agent services

The recorded demo buys venue data and a stage card over x402, within a human-defined budget. Open the dashboard to inspect each testnet payment.

The platform underneath

Built around a place.
Open to what comes next.

Organizers can commission custom immersive environments. Brands and developers can commission activations and services within those spaces. Programmable advertising is the next product layer.

Discovery in the browser

Web 3D, QR/NFC access and AR pathways on supported devices, without making a wallet the first step.

Stellar for the transaction layer

The agent demo composes x402 and test USDC with a SEP-41 budget ceiling. Visitor wallets remain a separate pilot; advertising contracts are planned.
